seo.meta_description: Shady Maple Smorgasbord buffet prices for 2026: breakfast, lunch and dinner per person, the themed dinner nights, and what's on America's largest buffet.

price_disclaimer: Prices are approximate, are provided as a guide only, and vary by day and season. Shady Maple is an all-you-can-eat smorgasbord priced per person, so individual items do not have prices and calories vary with what you choose. Prices are from Shady Maple's posted price list, before a 12% service fee and tax. Last updated November 2026.
intro: Shady Maple Smorgasbord in East Earl, Pennsylvania, is often called the largest buffet in America, a Lancaster County institution with over 200 feet of Pennsylvania Dutch comfort food. It is priced per person by meal, with themed dinner nights (steak, seafood, prime rib and more), and is famous for its scrapple, fried chicken, carved prime rib and pies. Below are the full Shady Maple buffet prices for 2026.
quick_answer: Shady Maple is an all-you-can-eat smorgasbord priced per person: weekday breakfast is $14.99, weekday lunch $20.99, and weeknight dinner $27.99 to $30.99 depending on the themed night (Steak, Seafood, Prime Rib and more). Saturday breakfast is $17.99, the Saturday Early Bird $29.99 and the Saturday Grand Menu $32.99. A 12% service fee is added. It is famous as America's largest buffet, with Pennsylvania Dutch comfort food. Senior and kids discounts apply.
hot_deal: Shady Maple value: weekday breakfast ($14.99) is the cheapest way in, and kids 3 and under eat free while kids 4 to 10 get 50% off. Seniors 60 and up get 10% off. The whole concept is all-you-can-eat value, with themed dinner nights (steak, seafood, prime rib) all at one price. Senior and kids discounts apply, so ask at the register.

faqs.q: How much is the Shady Maple buffet?
faqs.a: It is priced per person: weekday breakfast $14.99, weekday lunch $20.99, and weeknight dinner $27.99 to $30.99. Saturday breakfast is $17.99, the Saturday Early Bird $29.99 and the Saturday Grand Menu $32.99. A 12% service fee is added. Kids 3 and under eat free, kids 4 to 10 get 50% off, and seniors 60+ get 10% off.

faqs.q: Is Shady Maple the largest buffet in America?
faqs.a: Shady Maple Smorgasbord in East Earl, Pennsylvania, is widely described as the largest buffet in the United States, with over 200 feet of food. It is a Lancaster County landmark drawing visitors from across the region.

faqs.q: What are the themed dinner nights at Shady Maple?
faqs.a: The dinner buffet rotates a theme each night: Monday Steak Night ($27.99), Tuesday Seafood ($30.99), Wednesday Prime Rib ($27.99), Thursday Rib & Wing ($27.99), and Friday Grand Menu ($29.99). The lineup can change, so check before you go.

faqs.q: What food is on the Shady Maple buffet?
faqs.a: It is Pennsylvania Dutch comfort food across more than 200 feet: scrapple and eggs, fried chicken, carved prime rib and brisket, fried shrimp, pierogies, hot sides, a salad bar, breads, and a huge spread of pies and desserts.

faqs.q: What is Shady Maple best known for?
faqs.a: Shady Maple is best known as America's largest buffet and a Lancaster County institution, famous for its Pennsylvania Dutch cooking, including scrapple, fried chicken, carved prime rib and its enormous dessert and pie selection.
